data.notes: July 2026 is unusually stacked in Amsterdam, with stadium pop/R&B runs, Pride-linked club events, and major outdoor electronic and multicultural festivals clustered around the final two weekends.

events.title: Dekmantel Festival 2026
events.venueName: Amsterdamse Bos, Oude Kerk, Melkweg and Paradiso
events.summary: Dekmantel’s 12th edition runs July 29 to August 2, expanding across Amsterdamse Bos and city venues with 160+ electronic acts. The announced programme includes DARKSIDE, Helena Hauff, Ricardo Villalobos, DJ Sprinkles, Skrillex and Underground Resistance.

events.title: Bruno Mars – The Romantic Tour
events.summary: Bruno Mars brings The Romantic Tour to Johan Cruijff ArenA for an Amsterdam run on July 2, 4, 5 and 7, with Anderson .Paak as DJ Pee .Wee and Victoria Monét listed as special guests.

events.title: Milkshake Festival 2026
events.summary: Milkshake Festival returns to Westerpark on July 25 and 26 as an open-minded dance festival rooted in electronic, house, disco, pop, techno, R&B and dancehall programming.

events.title: World Pride Music Festival
events.summary: World Pride Music Festival is confirmed for July 31 and August 1 at AFAS Live, running from 22:00 to 07:00 each night as a large-scale Pride music event.

events.title: Kwaku Summer Festival
events.summary: Kwaku Summer Festival returns to Nelson Mandela Park from July 11 to August 2, combining live music, food and cultural programming. Confirmed Friday Night Concert names on the festival site include En Vogue, Broederliefde and Kassav’.

events.title: No Art Closing Festival
events.summary: No Art closes in Flevopark with a high-profile house lineup including ANOTR, Mau P, Seth Troxler, The Martinez Brothers, Rossi, Rooléh and Toman.

events.title: JOY x FLOW Festival
events.summary: JOY and FLOW join forces at Hembrugterrein on the edge of Amsterdam/Zaanstad, with three stages and a house-led lineup including Franky Rizardo, Prunk, Sidney Charles, Benny Rodrigues b2b Dennis Quin and Luuk van Dijk b2b L.P. Rhythm.

events.title: No Art Opening Festival
events.summary: No Art opens its festival run with ANOTR, Mochakk, Rüfüs Du Sol DJ set, Toman, Hannecart and Rooléh at Sportpark Riekerhaven.

events.title: Multigroove Festival
events.summary: Amsterdam rave institution Multigroove returns to Gaasperplas for a full-day harder-styles event, with artists including Catscan, Dano, The Darkraver, DJ Isaac, Partyraiser, Promo and Ruffneck.

events.title: Âme DJ x Sama' Abdulhadi
events.summary: Lofi pairs Âme DJ’s psychedelic house and restrained techno with Sama’ Abdulhadi’s fast, tightly locked techno pressure for one full night.

events.title: PRNCPTL DOES AMSTERDAM - DAY & NIGHT
events.summary: Pornceptual makes its Lofi debut with a day-into-night edition running from open-air afternoon energy into a full nocturnal club session.

events.title: XLSIOR Mykonos – Amsterdam edition
events.summary: XLSIOR Mykonos debuts in Amsterdam on July 31 as part of WorldPride 2026 at Panama Amsterdam. The Pride Amsterdam listing names Eliad Cohen, JUNYO and Manuel Coby among the DJs for the Olympians edition.

events.title: SONA presents: PAWSA In The Park
events.summary: SONA brings PAWSA for an extended open-air daytime house party at Havenpark, listed as sold out with resale active on RA.

events.title: RAUM invites Mala Junta
events.summary: Club RAUM’s WorldPride-linked DESIRE programme invites Berlin collective Mala Junta, with Hyperaktivist, D. Tiffany, Yazzus, DJ TOOL and more across a late-night session.

events.title: Thuishaven with Kerri Chandler / Dennis Quin / D Stone
events.summary: Thuishaven hosts a Sunday daytime house session headlined by Kerri Chandler with Dennis Quin, D Stone, Keyrah, LI-YU and Suze Ijó.

events.title: LAUNDRETTE ...IsBurning
events.summary: LAUNDRETTE joins IsBurning for a WorldPride opening party at Lofi, with a secret house-focused lineup.

events.title: Festival Macumba
events.summary: Festival Macumba brings Latin music to De Ven in Spaarnwoude near Amsterdam, with confirmed live and DJ acts including Elena Rose, La Cendejas, Gia Fu, Gerardo Rosales y su Salsa Legendaria and Fiesta Macumba Soundsystem.

events.title: PALET Mini Festival
events.summary: PALET stages a 15-hour day-into-night mini festival at Lofi with inside and outside areas focused on house and disco energy.

events.title: James Taylor and His All-Star Band
events.summary: James Taylor performs at AFAS Live on July 21 with his All-Star Band, in a seated singer-songwriter concert promoted by MOJO.

events.title: Madness
events.summary: British ska-pop veterans Madness play AFAS Live on July 7, returning to the Amsterdam venue with a show built around their long-running catalogue.
